article.story: NEWARK, N.J. -- — Roddie Anderson III scored 15 points and Seton Hall beat Saint Peter's 66-42 on Monday night in a season opener. Anderson added three steals for the Pirates. TJ Copeland Jr. added 10 points. Bryce Eaton finished with 16 points and two steals for the Peacocks. Ken Walker scored eight. Seton Hall took the lead for good with 13:53 left in the first half. The score was 36-18 at the break with Anderson racking up 10 points. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
